tools.name: device_fpga_de10lite_program
tools.description: Program a Quartus .sof bitstream through quartus_pgm and report its native result. Optional post-program scope checks verify the measured signal behavior against the supplied limits.

sof_path.description: Absolute path to the .sof bitstream to program (host-side).

cable_name.description: Quartus programmer cable name. 'USB-Blaster' picks the first one found.

device_index.description: Index of the device in the JTAG chain (1-based; DE10-Lite has only one device).

post_burn_scope_checks.description: v0.66: JSON-encoded list of scope-check dicts forwarded to scope_periodic_pulse_check.py after a successful burn. Each entry: {name, channel, span_ms, period_ms, pulse_min_us, pulse_max_us, expect (present/absent), min_periodic, trigger_timeout_s, save_csv}. Any FAIL flips overall success to False so the caller discovers silicon-vs-spec drift within seconds of the burn rather than two days later via manual probe. Example: [{"name":"post_por_wake_active","channel":4,"span_ms":100,"period_ms":5,"expect":"present","min_periodic":5}]

tools.name: device_fpga_de10lite_detect
tools.description: List USB-Blaster JTAG cables visible to Quartus and the chained devices on each. Returns { cables: [{ name, devices: [{idx, id_hex, name}] }] }. Useful for sanity-checking hardware before invoking program.

tools.name: device_fpga_de10lite_adc_read
tools.description: Read analog voltage from DE10-Lite MAX10 internal 12-bit ADC via JTAG system-console. v0.108: hardware-in-the-loop analog verification. Requires an FPGA design with the ADC Controller Intel FPGA IP instantiated and the JTAG-to-Avalon bridge connected. Returns averaged raw ADC code and computed voltage in mV.

channel.description: ADC channel (0-7, mapped to MAX10 analog input pins ADC_INn).

samples.description: Number of ADC samples to average for noise reduction.

reference_mv.description: ADC reference voltage in mV. MAX10 internal reference is 2.5V.

adc_base_addr.description: Avalon-MM base address of the ADC Controller IP (from Platform Designer).

resources.name: programmer_status
resources.description: Live read of USB-Blaster JTAG cables visible to Quartus and the devices on each chain. No programming, no side effects — just runs `quartus_pgm --list` then `--auto` per cable. Lets MCP clients introspect 'is the FPGA plugged in and what's on the JTAG chain?' before invoking the program tool.
